findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search · Private data: scan_token, colony_activity, swoge_economy, new_launches, wallet_intel, ask_agent, generate_image, generate_video · Public sink: colony_activity, swoge_economy, generate_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search · Private data: scan_token, colony_activity, swoge_economy, new_launches, wallet_intel, ask_agent, generate_image, generate_video · Public sink: colony_activity, swoge_economy, generate_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
